title: Battery
description: Shows how much battery is left and whether it is charging.

placeholders.description: An icon from "Icons" that matches the level.
Time left until full or empty.
The clock time when it will be full or empty.
How many charge cycles the battery has done.

bat.label: Battery
bat.doc: The battery to monitor, as in /sys/class/power_supply/ instead of auto detect.
bat.description: Which battery to watch, like BAT0. Empty chooses automatically.

adapter.label: Charger
adapter.doc: The adapter to monitor, as in /sys/class/power_supply/ instead of auto detect.
adapter.description: Which charger to watch, like AC. Empty chooses automatically.

full-at.label: Consider full at
full-at.doc: Define the max percentage of the battery, for when you've set the battery to stop charging at a lower level to save it. For example, if you've set the battery to stop at 80% that will become the new 100%.
full-at.description: If you limit charging (for example to 80% to protect the battery), set it here so 80% shows as 100%.

design-capacity.label: Use original capacity
design-capacity.doc: Option to use the battery design capacity instead of its current maximal capacity.
design-capacity.description: Calculate the percentage from the capacity the battery had when new.

full-at-plugged.label: Show "plugged" instead of "full"
full-at-plugged.doc: When enabled, a battery that is Full while the adapter is online is reported with the Plugged status instead of Full (so you can style/format it separately). Disabled by default to preserve the existing Full behaviour.
full-at-plugged.description: When enabled, a battery that is Full while the adapter is online is reported with the Plugged status instead of Full (so you can style/format it separately). Disabled by default to preserve the existing Full behaviour.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the information gets polled.
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

smooth-power.label: Steadier time estimate
smooth-power.doc: Enable exponential smoothing of the battery power reading used to estimate the {time} remaining, so the estimate fluctuates less between refreshes.
smooth-power.description: Make the remaining time jump around less.

smooth-power-time-constant.label: Steadiness
smooth-power-time-constant.doc: The time constant (in seconds) of the smooth-power exponential filter. Only used when smooth-power is enabled. Values below 1.0 are clamped to 1.0.
smooth-power-time-constant.description: The time constant (in seconds) of the smooth-power exponential filter. Only used when smooth-power is enabled. Values below 1.0 are clamped to 1.0.

states.label: Battery levels
states.doc: A number of battery states which get activated on certain capacity levels. See waybar-states(5).
states.description: Name some levels, like "warning": 30 and "critical": 15. Then you can show a different text or color when the battery is low.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed.

format-time.label: Time format
format-time.doc: The format, how the time should be displayed.
format-time.description: How {time} is written. {H} is hours and {M} is minutes.

format-eta.label: End time format
format-eta.doc: The format of the estimated local time at which the battery will be full or empty. See https://fmt.dev/latest/syntax/#chrono-format-specifications for the available specifiers.
format-eta.description: How {eta} (the clock time when the battery will be full or empty) is written.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the current capacity, the corresponding icon gets selected. The order is low to high. Or by the state if it is an object.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

weighted-average.label: Combine batteries by size
weighted-average.doc: Option to combine multiple batteries with different capacities.
weighted-average.description: Option to combine multiple batteries with different capacities.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The tooltip format. See CUSTOM FORMATS for status/state-specific variants.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

bat-compatibility.label: Compatibility mode
bat-compatibility.doc: Option to enable battery compatibility if not detected.
bat-compatibility.description: Turn on if your battery isn't detected.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu.
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

events.label: Run commands on battery events
events.doc: Specifies commands to be executed on specific battery states. See EVENTS section below.
events.description: Commands to run, for example when the battery becomes low.
